messages:
kai: quick sync 1: we pushed private/vpc RC6 bundles to staging: full-installer v6.0.0-rc6 and delta-pack. planning a limited canary 2026-04-05 01:00-02:00 UTC.
mira: good. can we confirm cosign sigs + key id? last rotation confused a few bundles.
jon: checked: cosign key = projects/redwood/keys/ops-kms-2026; signatures present. manifest at gs://redwood-artifacts/private/rc6/manifest.json.sha256
priya: caught a mismatch in the manifest: connector-image is `private/connector:ci-1234` not an rc tag. we need to republish and re-hash before canary.
kai: ok republish + manifest update required. deploy-bot should block until all images are pinned.
deploy-bot: [automated] preflight: artifacts exist, cosign ok, manifest hash mismatch: 1 unresolved tag. status: BLOCKED
mira: i'll build/push `private/connector:rc6-2026-04` and update the manifest. will also attach cosign sigs.
jon: also add a checksum verification step in the runbook: `sha256sum -c manifest.sha256` before starting deploy-bot.
priya: agree. also let's add a quick smoke script that exercises the installer in airgap mode on a VM (no cloud). keeps the canary faithful to customer env.
kai: plan: 1) pin images 2) upload signed manifest 3) run airgap smoke on staging vm 4) deploy-bot start canary at 01:00 UTC (5% -> 25% if healthy) 5) monitor metrics 30m -> 60m then decide. fallback: immediate `deploy-bot rollback --to v5.9.2` and revoke traffic.
deploy-bot: ack, gating checks: artifacts, cosign, manifest-hash, smoke-result, metric-checks. will abort on `prompt-eval-regression > 1.5%` or `install-failure-rate > 0.5%`
mira: smoke run started in staging VM now (vm-staging-12). will report results in ~15m.
priya: adding release notes short blurb for compliance: "RC6 (Private/VPC): installer delta-pack reduces transfer volume; cosign key unchanged; KMS rotation impacts handled out-of-band." can someone sign off?
jon: LGTM, please include CVE note about base image patching.
kai: approved. mira drop the final manifest SHA and release-note into this thread when ready.
mira: smoke finished: installer run successful, post-install services up, health_checks=OK.
mira: uploaded new manifest: sha256:bb7a2c4... and cosign signatures uploaded.
deploy-bot: revalidated manifest & signatures. all gates passed. ready for canary window 2026-04-05T01:00Z.
ops-bot: reminder: change window scheduled 2026-04-05 01:00-03:00 UTC. page #eng-oncall if rollback. oncall: jon primary, priya backup.
jon: i'll be oncall. quick check: do we have staged rollback artifacts for offline customers?
priya: yes - we keep v5.9.2 sealed bundle in staging-bucket/offline/release-v5.9.2 and signer key retained for rollback.
kai: one more constraint: legal asked that all release notes include the list of third-party license changes. mira can you paste that in before we flip the canary?
mira: adding license appendix now. will post final release notes snippet here in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jon: running a dry-run of the rollback commands at 00:30 UTC to ensure `deploy-bot rollback --to v5.9.2 --evict-lb` works and artifacts are reachable.
priya: i ran a local dry-run earlier, it succeeded but note: after rollback we need to clear cached installer chunks on CDN edge (edge-cache-invalidate). runbook updated.
kai: excellent. final: legal/release-team need the signed release notes by EOD PDT. mira to drop final blob. if dry-run goes well we proceed to canary.
mira: final release note snippet: "Private/VPC RC6 (v6.0.0-rc6): delta-pack enabled to shrink airgap payloads; cosign key ops-kms-2026 used; known issue: automatic KMS rotation not included in this release; offline rollback bundle v5.9.2 available." posted to release-ticket #RL-2217. :white_check_mark:
kai: thanks all. ping this thread when dry-run completes or if any gate flips to BLOCKED. :thumbsup:
